sloka: एकेन वानरेणेयं पूर्वं दग्धा महापुरी ।कुमारो निहतश्चाक्षः सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ।। ६.६०.७६ ।।।।
transliteration: ekena vānareṇeyaṁ pūrvaṁ dagdhā mahāpurī ।kumāro nihataścākṣaḥ sānuyātraḥ sakuñjaraḥ ।। 6.60.76 ।।।।

translations.english: "The king could escape from the verge of death and such an act was never done by Daityas or Danavas earlier in the encounter."
